BiblicalUsage: Once, in Proverbs 16:26: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him. The word is the press of hunger — the appetite that drives a man to his work.
TheologicalSignificance: One verse about hunger's press carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is Proverbs' plain honesty, that need is the foreman that never lets a man rest.
